input.summary: Extend the Base Components licence to Customer's Affiliates upon written notice to IBM.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the Base Components licence to our Affiliates upon written notice to IBM, as our licence playbook requires affiliate coverage; the existing assignment clause already permits transfer of this Agreement to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition, so no further change is needed there.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer and, upon written notice to IBM, Customer's Affiliates a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
